facts.fact: Menos Fios, relaying Expansao no. 878 and Infosi, reports the state-built Government National Data Centre and Cloud at Camama has Tier III certified modules, with the building awaiting Uptime assessment, and it hosts data of public and private institutions.

facts.fact: The Government National Data Centre and Cloud, run by the state institute Infosi, is a state facility inaugurated on 28 April 2026.
